reference.selection: Source-informed site and interval; no external fitted parameters used

time_holdout.selection: Different interval at same site, chosen before local detector or fitting results; not independent-site validation

receiver_height_basis: Fixed broad-region engineering assumption, not a value derived from deployment coordinates
interpretation: No event and rejected fit are preserved; source-informed replay and within-site time holdout remain separate. Exact publisher receiver coordinates never enter discovery or fitting inputs. Public metadata supports independent location comparison, not certified sub-100-m accuracy.
